=== Quick Fix Inventory ===

[D1] (9:23-9:33) TS377169: Effect.try is called without a `catch` handler, so failures surface as the generic `UnknownError`. The object form `{ try, catch }` maps the cause to a typed, domain-specific error. effect(effectTryWithoutCatch)
  Fix 0: "Disable effectTryWithoutCatch for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable effectTryWithoutCatch for entire file"
  Fix 2: "Add a catch handler (object form)"

[D2] (14:22-14:32) TS377021: The `catch` callback in `Effect.try` returns `unknown`, so the Effect error type stays untyped. A specific typed error preserves error-channel information, for example by narrowing the value or wrapping it in `Data.TaggedError`. effect(unknownInEffectCatch)
  Fix 0: "Disable unknownInEffectCatch for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable unknownInEffectCatch for entire file"

=== [D1] Fix 2: "Add a catch handler (object form)" ===

--- file:///.src/effectTryWithoutCatch_handover.ts ---
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics effectTryWithoutCatch:warning
// @effect-diagnostics unknownInEffectCatch:warning
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const text: string

// MUST TRIGGER effectTryWithoutCatch: the fix rewrites it to the form below
export const before = Effect.try({ try: () => JSON.parse(text), catch: (cause) => cause })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER effectTryWithoutCatch, MUST TRIGGER unknownInEffectCatch: the
// quick fix's output; its placeholder catch returns unknown, so unknownInEffectCatch
// takes over and asks for a domain error
export const after = Effect.try({ try: () => JSON.parse(text), catch: (cause) => cause })
